title: Surge Guardrail: Fleet Scaling Conductor UI, Throughput Insights, and Immutable Change Chronicle
creator: Asha Mattingly
description: Deliver a new Fleet Scaling Conductor panel in Console focused on proactive surge guardrails, a throughput insights dashboard, and an immutable change chronicle for operator actions. This ticket covers the product requirements and acceptance criteria for the UI surface, operator workflows for soft vs firm throughput guarantees, cost/impact previews for scaling decisions, and an auditable history that can’t be edited by operators. The goal is to reduce production incidents from over-provisioning and sudden traffic spikes while giving platform operators predictable controls and a clear rollback path.
acceptance_criteria: Conductor panel exposes three primary controls: target throughput (rps/tokens/s), surge headroom percentage, and soft-vs-firm guarantee toggle
Throughput Insights dashboard shows per-fleet token/s, P50/P95 latency, queue-length heatmap, and cost-per-1k-token with 1h / 6h / 24h aggregations
Change Chronicle records immutable entries for: who, what (config diff), when, why (free-text), and simulated impact summary; entries are searchable and downloadable as CSV
Operators can run a dry-run simulation that projects latency and cost impact for a proposed change using recent traffic distribution (no live change applied)
Ability to create named scaling presets and pin them to rollout policies (canary, linear rollout, immediate), with quick revert to previously pinned preset
Telemetry emitted for each applied change: change_id, fleet_id, new_target, old_target, simulation_delta_cost, simulation_delta_p95, rollout_strategy
UI integrates with RBAC: only users with fleet:modify may apply changes; viewers can access insights and simulation but not apply
Automated smoke rollback trigger in case applied change increases p95 > 2x baseline or error-rate > 0.5% for > 5 minutes
ux_notes: Primary panel chrome follows Console layout: left nav quick switch between Fleets, right side contextual timeline
Conductor uses an intent-based form: operator selects metric objective (throughput / latency / cost), then gets recommended presets
Surge Guardrail slider expresses headroom as % and absolute tokens/sec estimate; tooltip explains that soft guarantees allow autoscaler to scale down under sustained low load
Simulation modal shows three panes: traffic distribution, projected latency curve, and cost delta with 95% confidence band
Change Chronicle is read-only for non-ops; each entry links to the corresponding GitHub PR or incident (optional)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal beta): launch to SRE and Platform teams on dedicated staging fleets (2 weeks) to validate simulations and telemetry
Phase 2 (pilot customers): invite two enterprise customers with dedicated fleets for guided runs and feedback (3 weeks)
Phase 3 (general availability): GA behind feature flag for all Dedicated customers; gradual ramp with telemetry checks (2 weeks)
Rollback: UI-level revert to previous preset + automatic rollback on telemetry triggers; engineering runbook ENG-12920 documents step-by-step
metrics_and_dashboard_queries: fleet:token_rate_per_sec - aggregation: avg, window: 1m; used by Throughput Insights main tile
fleet:latency_p50, fleet:latency_p95 - rollup 1m/5m/1h for trend visualization
fleet:queue_length - histogram heatmap over 24h to power concurrency hotspots
sim:cost_delta - estimated cost difference for proposed change over next 24h using last 7d traffic seasonality
alert:smoke_rollback - p95 > 2x baseline OR error_rate > 0.5% sustained >5m
